case_098:
Real defect on deep_jewel: all three variants are achromatic (black jacket, grey-taupe cardigan, black top) with garment mean saturation 0.06-0.09 against 0.16-0.29 elsewhere on this sheet, so no jewel hue at all; broken_dry also absent, contours are smooth and continuous rather than broken/dry. -- overturned at full resolution: Resolved case_098 -> style_id `linework_coloring_broken_dry_deep_jewel_transparent_glaze_controlled_rim_complete_line_color`, test_ids P7000292 (seed 1001), P7000293 (2002), P7000294 (3003). Opened all three at 1024x1024.

BROKEN_DRY — claim refuted, this was a pure thumbnail artifact. At full resolution the dry/broken contour treatment is unmistakable in every seed: P7000292's left shoulder/silhouette edge against the grey ground is a granular, torn, speckled edge with dry-brush striations running through the hair mass, and the lapel line drops out and restarts; P7000293's cardigan is drawn with thin lines that visibly break and re-enter (shoulder seam, neckline, sleeve line all dashed and interrupted); P7000294's shoulder line and internal fold strokes are discontinuous tapering dashes with gaps. Side-by-side against a rounded_soft / angular_precise sibling at the same crop (P7000733, P7000031) the difference is obvious — those have clean continuous edges, case_098 does not. At contact-sheet scale the broken edge collapses into an apparently solid line, which is exactly how the reviewer read it as "smooth and continuous".

DEEP_JEWEL / SATURATION — the numeric evidence does not reproduce and its comparison basis was invalid. The review cited garment mean saturation 0.06-0.09 "against 0.16-0.29 elsewhere on this sheet" — a cross-palette comparison against sheet neighbours from other coloring groups, which is precisely the fallacy tests/reports/phase7_linework_coloring_v2/saturation_screen.json exists to catch. The screen groups by `coloring`: deep_jewel has 43 items, median 0.1628, min 0.1107, max 0.2117, outlier_count 0 (outlier_total 0 across all 300 items). My own recomputation of the three renders gives whole-image HSV S = 0.190 / 0.195 / 0.168 and garment-band S = 0.239 / 0.248 / 0.148 — at or above its own group's median, nowhere near 0.06-0.09. Per the screening rule, that is not evidence of a defect.

The residual observation is true but not case-specific: the garments really are near-neutral (garment mean chroma 7.3/255, warm grey-black, no jewel hue) — but that is the norm for this group under a tight thigh-up crop, not an anomaly. Measuring garment chroma across all 43 deep_jewel items at seed 1001 gives a range of 5.1-18.4 with median ~11.6; six items sit lower than case_098 (P7000727 5.1, P7000808 5.4, P7000733 5.8, P7000715 6.9, P7000019 6.9), and its nearest sibling P7000295 (same broken_dry + deep_jewel + transparent_glaze, only the edge accent differs) is a fully black suit at chroma 13.5. Items that do show visible emerald (P7000004 at 18.4, P7000031 at 10.0) are the ones where the coat occupies more canvas. So the achromatic garment is a group-wide crop/garment-choice characteristic, not a case_098 regression.

Verdict: the hold does not survive at full resolution. The broken_dry half is affirmatively wrong, and the deep_jewel half rests on numbers that neither reproduce nor clear the own-group threshold.

Seed 2002 is decisive: a thin, even-width dark contour runs continuously around both hands, every finger separation, the sleeve cuffs, the neckline and the garment fold breaks, with clean joins at fingertips and knuckles — unambiguous crisp_uniform linework. Seed 1001 carries the same thin uniform contour on the hands, finger undersides, wrists and cuffs; the reviewer's specific observation is correct that the right garment-to-background transition is a darker value edge rather than an ink line, but that is the broad_blended_plane treatment ("keeping silhouette edges clear") and does not negate the uniform contour present across the rest of the figure. Seed 3003 is the most painterly of the three, yet at 1:1 its facial contours are crisp and exact (eyelid lines, nostril, lip line, consistently open eyes) and finger separations are thin even strokes, so it is not a counterexample. Objective confirmation: luminance scans across the hand region at three rows per seed give dark-run widths of 2-5 px in all three renders (the wider 10-27 px runs are cast shadow between the hands), i.e. consistent thin-line width rather than variable-weight or brush-modulated edges. Saturation was not the concern, but the item's own palette group muted_split_complement (43 items, median 0.155, range 0.1285-0.1986) reports outlier_count 0 and the axis outlier_total is 0, so there is no saturation evidence either. One non-blocking observation: the split-complement pairing is plain in 1001 (teal-blue shirt against olive khaki skirt) but weaker in 2002 and 3003, where the garment is blue-only against the warm-grey ground; this was not the flagged defect and the palette remains within its group tolerance.
